metadata.title: Exploring Influencing Factors at Student and Teacher/School levels on Science Self-efficacy Using Machine Learning and Multilevel Latent Profile Analysis

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used WLE scores, which do not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study does not mention the application of sampling weights in the analysis of student-level data.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study employed multilevel latent profile analysis, which accounts for the hierarchical structure of the data.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed only internal validation through various regression algorithms without mentioning any external validation.
